b-013.reason: garde: nous auons en garde l'ame = 'we have the soul in keeping', echoed six words on by prins à garder and at the end by baillee en garde; gaide is no word.

b-019.reason: balliee = baillée, 'delivered' (commise, & baillee en garde, the pair committed and delivered into keeping); ballice is no word, a misread of e as c.
